title: Simple Folk Tune
description: A slow, three-chord practice song built for looping the same change over and over.

title: Campfire Sing-Along
description: One of the most common three-chord progressions in popular music, worth knowing cold.

title: Slow Ballad Progression
description: A gentler tempo song that gives you more time to think through each chord change.

title: Wagon Wheel
description: A four-chord singalong that loops the same progression through the whole song.

title: Knockin' on Heaven's Door
description: A slow, spacious progression that's forgiving for early strumming practice.

title: Horse With No Name
description: Only two chord shapes for the entire song, great for building strumming stamina.

title: Three Little Birds
description: An upbeat reggae strum pattern layered over a simple three-chord loop.

title: Ho Hey
description: The classic four-chord pop loop, useful for practicing quick changes between shapes.

title: I'm Yours
description: Introduces a syncopated strum pattern on top of familiar open chord shapes.

title: Riptide
description: A percussive strum with muted hits, good for building rhythmic control.

title: Wonderwall
description: A steady eighth-note strum with a chord run that's a rite of passage for new players.

title: Banana Pancakes
description: A laid-back groove that rewards a relaxed, controlled strumming hand.

title: Stand By Me
description: A classic doo-wop progression, useful practice for barre-adjacent chord shapes.

title: Blackbird
description: A fingerpicked piece that trains independent thumb and finger movement.

title: Dust in the Wind
description: A fingerstyle pattern with a moving bass line across each chord shape.

title: Tears in Heaven
description: A fingerpicked ballad with subtle chord substitutions worth studying closely.
